business_purpose: Tracks the predictable monthly revenue base. Primary leading indicator of business health and growth trajectory.
risk_if_misread: Including canceled subscriptions inflates MRR and masks revenue loss.

business_purpose: Measures revenue efficiency per customer. Used to evaluate pricing strategy and segment-level monetisation.
risk_if_misread: Using total customers (including inactive) as denominator deflates ARPU.

business_purpose: Quantifies revenue generated from upsells and plan upgrades. A growing expansion revenue signals successful product-led growth.
risk_if_misread: Treating all premium-plan MRR as expansion overstates growth if these were original plan choices, not upgrades.

business_purpose: Flags revenue that is contractually owed but not yet collected, signalling billing health risk.
risk_if_misread: Ignoring this metric leads to MRR overstatement and delayed churn response.

business_purpose: Measures what percentage of possible revenue is actually being retained, ignoring expansion. Core SaaS health benchmark.
risk_if_misread: Confusing GRR with NRR leads to overestimating retention when expansion is masking underlying churn.

business_purpose: The gold-standard SaaS retention metric. An NRR above 1.0 means the existing customer base is growing revenue without new acquisition.
risk_if_misread: Using NRR without GRR hides whether growth comes from retention or expansion.

business_purpose: Quantifies the dollar value exposed to churn so finance and CS can prioritise retention investment.
risk_if_misread: Underestimating at-risk revenue leads to under-resourcing customer success.

business_purpose: Measures what proportion of signed-up customers completed the minimum set of actions indicating they derived initial value from the product.
risk_if_misread: Using logins instead of key_actions conflates presence with engagement.

business_purpose: Tracks how frequently customers engage with the product. Declining frequency is an early churn signal.
risk_if_misread: Averaging across all customers including inactive ones deflates frequency.

business_purpose: Measures how productively customers use each session. Low key action rate indicates friction or lack of product discovery.
risk_if_misread: High key_action totals for a single power-user segment can mask poor broader adoption.

business_purpose: Identifies customers in active decline before they reach the churned state. Key early-warning intervention trigger.
risk_if_misread: Point-in-time measurement without trend context misses seasonal patterns.

business_purpose: Approximates how broadly customers explore the product feature set. Sticky customers tend to use more features.
risk_if_misread: High features_used count does not guarantee adoption of high-value features.

business_purpose: Primary retention health metric. Sustained churn above 3% monthly signals structural product or market fit issues.
risk_if_misread: Using total customers including trials in denominator understates churn rate.

business_purpose: Complement of churn rate. Retention rate above 97% monthly is a strong SaaS health signal.
risk_if_misread: High headline retention can mask segment-level retention differences.

business_purpose: Measures customer sentiment and likelihood to recommend. Strong leading indicator of organic growth and churn risk.
risk_if_misread: Low response rate (under 30%) makes mean NPS unreliable as a population estimate.

business_purpose: Measures how much operational support load the customer base generates. High support burden correlates with poor product experience and churn risk.
risk_if_misread: Using raw ticket count without normalising by customer count biases toward larger customer bases.

business_purpose: Measures onboarding velocity. Shorter time to activation correlates with higher 90-day retention. A key lever for onboarding optimisation.
risk_if_misread: Including non-activated customers with no activation date skews the mean toward infinity or NaN.

business_purpose: Measures profit after deducting direct production or delivery costs.
risk_if_misread: Excluding indirect costs overstates gross profit.

business_purpose: Measures production/delivery efficiency as a decimal 0-1.
risk_if_misread: Including non-COGS costs deflates gross margin.

business_purpose: Tracks core operational profitability before interest and taxes.
risk_if_misread: Excluding one-time charges inflates margin.

business_purpose: Bottom-line profitability after all expenses.
risk_if_misread: Excluding tax or interest expense overstates net margin.

business_purpose: Approximates operational cash generation. Widely used for cross-company comparison and valuation multiples.
risk_if_misread: Treating EBITDA as free cash flow ignores capex and working capital.

business_purpose: Measures the profitability of an investment relative to its cost.
risk_if_misread: Ignoring time horizon inflates ROI for long-duration investments.

business_purpose: Annualises the recurring revenue base for investor reporting.
risk_if_misread: Using total revenue instead of MRR inflates ARR.

business_purpose: Measures the rate of revenue expansion or contraction between periods.
risk_if_misread: Comparing different period lengths distorts the rate.

business_purpose: Identifies dependency on individual customers. High concentration increases risk.
risk_if_misread: Measuring by contract value rather than recognised revenue is misleading.

business_purpose: Estimates the total gross-margin-adjusted revenue expected from a customer.
risk_if_misread: Using total revenue instead of gross margin overstates LTV.

business_purpose: Total sales and marketing investment to acquire one new customer.
risk_if_misread: Excluding any acquisition spend component understates CAC.

business_purpose: The primary unit economics health metric. A ratio >= 3.0 is the SaaS benchmark.
risk_if_misread: A high ratio driven by very low CAC may indicate under-investment.

business_purpose: Cash available after sustaining and expanding the asset base.
risk_if_misread: Confusing FCF with net income ignores non-cash and capex items.

business_purpose: Months the business can operate before exhausting cash reserves.
risk_if_misread: Using gross burn instead of net burn overstates urgency.

business_purpose: Tracks the rate at which the customer base expands or contracts.
risk_if_misread: Counting trials as customers inflates the rate.

business_purpose: Revenue growth generated per dollar of S&M investment.
risk_if_misread: Including expansion revenue inflates the efficiency metric.

business_purpose: Primary operational productivity benchmark.
risk_if_misread: Excluding contractors understates productivity.

business_purpose: Measures how effectively S&M spend converts to new revenue.
risk_if_misread: Including renewal revenue in new revenue inflates the metric.

business_purpose: Quantifies the revenue risk from over-reliance on a single customer.
risk_if_misread: Using ARR instead of recognised revenue misrepresents timing risk.

business_purpose: Proportion of total revenue threatened by high-risk customers.
risk_if_misread: Using customer count instead of revenue understates high-value impact.
